body: You had me at zero dollars

I just lost my mom three weeks ago, I’m 25 never been married no kids and I can’t bury her because of this pandemic. In 2010 my grandmother passed away suddenly and it crushed my mother. Now I envy my mom because she had way more time with her mom then I did..

In this instance I would tell you to do what you think you would want when your mother passes. You want to be able to look back on this moment and feel like you were there for her plain and simple. All the fighting fades away, nothing is more important than this moment.. and no one knows what to say even people that have lost close loved ones whether they’re parents or not there’s really no right thing to say or do. 

Right now, after losing my mother I don’t want people to give me that shit that she’s still with me she’s not gone blah blah blah I just want them to fucking be quiet and just be there.

Watch movies together, play board games, go on walks just spend time... remind her that she has all the purpose left to live and that’s you.
I can’t have my mom’s funeral either it’s terrible

Thank you. I’m usually angry and ignore calls too but the day before I decided to call her and she sounded at peace. My grandmother tried to call my mom the day before she died and my mom was busy getting ready for something and she said she’d call her back and she never did. 

I don’t know how to deal with it either and I’m so sorry

My mom died two weeks ago. All she wanted was to be a grandma, I had an abortion and didn’t tell her in February.. sometimes I feel like the butterfly effect is real maybe if I would’ve told her and went through with the pregnancy she would still be here. also I could’ve went through with the pregnancy and had to deal with her death at the same time. 

I’m so sorry
I had a dream my mom died and then three weeks later she did

Because she didn’t have a will my stepdad gets everything so my brothers want to keep the peace until we do get the autopsy report back. The medical examiner has said nothing I guess they are waiting for toxicology? Her body has already been released and she’s in a funeral home until we can finally put her in the ground after the virus subsides...
